terra.problem: Mark 4:1 does not say Jesus taught from the boat all day, and the passage does not say the crowd went home.
Mark 4:1 does not say Jesus taught from the boat all day. The passage also does not establish that He never had to walk up to anything.
The passage says Jesus was already in the boat when they took Him, not that He was aboard before the crowd left.
The pants-rolled-up joke makes an imagined picture of Jesus the joke.
The other boats are mentioned, but the text does not say who, if anyone, was aboard them.
The dry cookie sheet comparison does not make sense as a place the people aboard would want to be.
Waves breaking over the boat do not establish that nothing about it was holding still.
The text does not specify how quickly the wind died down. No waiting and one minute to the next add timing.
Nothing slow about it asserts a speed the text does not give.
The text does not say Jesus asked the questions in one breath.
Wisdom and faith are not close in sound.
The text says the disciples were overwhelmed with fear, not that they could not catch their breath.
